description:
Full replacement of the LangGraph-based workflow engine in the SDLC Agents 4 Enterprise VS Code extension with the Pi SDK (@earendil-works/pi-agent-core), following Option C: Full Replacement strategy.

See extension/docs/pi-migration-plan.md for the full plan.

Key Phases:
1. Install Pi SDK & Create Pi Provider
2. Build PiAgent Executor (single turn)
3. Implement Phase Router
4. Implement State & Checkpointer Adapters
5. Integration & Human Approval Logic
6. Testing, QA, and LangGraph Cleanup
